arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Kneedler stated two requirements for a state drug offense to be an aggravated felony.
He said the conduct must be punishable under federal law and be a felony.
Mr. Long defined a drug-trafficking crime as a felony punishable under federal statutes.
He emphasized that the term punishable is a key term in the definition.
